blocks.text: Har laboratory mein first aid box hona chahiye. Table 16.1 aam hadse aur un ke first aid ilaj deti hai.

blocks.caption: Table 16.1 Hadse aur un ka first aid ilaj
rows: Mamooli kat
sheeshe ka koi tukra ho to nikalein; rui se thori methylated spirit ya tincture iodine lagayein (dono jaraseem-kush hain)
Gehra kat
khoon rokne ko kat par taqreeban 10 minute dabao rakhein; doctor se rujoo karein
Aankh mein acid
pani se achhi tarah dhoyein, phir 1% sodium bicarbonate solution se
Aankh mein alkali
pani se dhoyein, phir 1% boric acid solution se
Aankh mein bahri zarra
malein nahi; narm roomal se zarra ehtiyat se nikalein, phir pani se dhoyein
Aankh mein dukhan
aankh mein zaitoon ke tel ka qatra, kuch der band rakhein
Khushk garmi se jalna (shola, garam cheez)
burnol ya sarson ka tel lagayein
Chhale wala jalna
khoob thande (ice-cold) pani se dhoyein, phir saturated sodium bicarbonate solution se, phir pani se
Acid se jalna
khoob pani se dhoyein, phir 1% acetic acid solution se, phir pani se; jild sukha kar burnol lagayein
Alkali se jalna
2% ammonia solution se poori tarah dhoyein aur glycerin lagayein; kuch der baad glycerin ponchh kar burnol lagayein
Zehar nigal liya
foran thookein; baar baar pani se munh dhoyein
Acid nigal liya
bohat sa pani, ya lime water, ya milk of magnesia piyein
Caustic alkali nigal liya
bohat sa pani piyein; lemon ya orange juice ka glass piyein
Bhari dhaat ka namak nigal liya
doodh ya ande ki safedi lein
Kapron ko aag lag gayi
bhaagein nahi; kambal ya khushk sooti kapre mein lipat jayein; farsh par let jayein
Aag pakarne wale liquid ke beaker ko aag lagi
beaker ko duster ya geele kapre se dhak dein taake oxygen ki rasad kat jaye
Spirit ya tel ko aag lagi
ret aur sodium bicarbonate ka mixture phenkein; pani kabhi nahi, woh aag phailata hai
Bijli ke purzon ko aag lagi
bijli ki supply foran band karein aur ret phenkein; pani kabhi nahi

blocks.text: Print ki table jalne ke neeche 'Bromine burns' likhti hai magar paanch qism ke jalne ke liye sirf chaar ilaj deti hai, to bromine ka alag ilaj print nahi hua. Quick Check 16.1 jalne ki mukhtalif qismein bhi poochta hai: table khushk garmi se jalna, chhale wala jalna, acid se jalna, alkali se jalna aur bromine se jalna ginti hai.

blocks.prompt: Lab mein sulfuric acid se jalne ka ilaj kaise hota hai, aur jalne ki mukhtalif qismein kya hain (Quick Check 16.1c, d; exercise Q.4)?
blocks.explanation: Acid se jalne ko khoob pani se, phir 1% acetic acid solution se aur dobara pani se dhoya jata hai; jild sukha kar burnol lagaya jata hai. Table 16.1 khushk garmi (shola ya garam cheez) se jalna, chhale wala jalna, acid se jalna, alkali se jalna aur bromine se jalna ginti hai.

items: Kat: jaraseem-kush (methylated spirit, tincture iodine) ya 10 minute dabao aur doctor. Aankh: acid, pani phir 1% NaHCO3; alkali, pani phir 1% boric acid; zarra, malein nahi; dukhan, zaitoon ka tel.
Jalna: khushk garmi, burnol ya sarson ka tel; chhale, thanda pani phir saturated NaHCO3; acid, pani, 1% acetic acid, pani, burnol; alkali, 2% ammonia, glycerin, burnol.

Zehar: thookein aur kulli; acid, pani, lime water ya milk of magnesia; alkali, pani aur lemon ya orange juice; bhari dhaat ka namak, doodh ya ande ki safedi. Aag: lipat kar let jayein; beaker dhakein; ret aur NaHCO3, tel ya bijli ki aag par kabhi pani nahi.
